verdict.rationale: Gusto documents that owners can connect it to Claude, ChatGPT and other AI tools to ask questions about payroll and teams, prep payroll and generate reports through its own MCP server. A Multi-Client MCP lets firms work across clients in a single AI conversation, an agent can prepare payroll decisions for owner approval, and Gus, an AI Benefits Assistant, gives conversational benefits guidance. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration (all evidence is vendor press releases), documentation of which actions beyond payroll prep and reports can be driven by natural language, and a native natural-language command interface beyond benefits guidance.
